title: Pedal-Actuated Locking Lever (Practice Mechanism)
summary: A deliberate practice project in original linkage design, built to close a portfolio gap around mechanism synthesis.
problem: Client-style mechanism design briefs require confident, from-scratch linkage synthesis — a skill best sharpened outside of billable client time.
approach: Designed a foot-pedal-actuated locking lever from first principles, validating the motion path and locking geometry in SolidWorks Motion before detailing the final assembly.
